_notes.cash: starting cash; the live account principal is 300,000. Per-slot sizing uses THIS fixed base (cash / max_positions), matching how cli.py sizes live orders — it does not compound.
_notes.pick_source: live = backtest/results/daily/pick_stocks_<date>.json first, else the backtest run's pick file for that date
_notes.max_positions: per_slot = cash / max_positions, whole 100-share lots; also caps how many positions are held at once
_notes.max_hold_days: null = read the regime's max_hold_days from backtest/config.json x HOLD_DAYS_MULT, floored at 1, the way the engine does. A number forces a fixed cap.
_notes.tp_mult: +200% off the previous close (the pre-market reference price), matching the engine's orders
_notes.buy_limit_mode: limit_up = prev_close x band (always in the auction) | prev_close_buffer | order_price
_notes.force_exit_codes: symbols to force-sell at the open regardless of brackets
